title: EGP Graphai • Bible Version
description: A single Bible version with metadata and per-testament overrides. Each version has its own _version.json file in its folder.

_id.description: Short identifier for the version, e.g., LXX, BYZ2018, EGP-EN.

license.description: License identifier, similar to package.json licensing (e.g., 'public-domain', 'copyright').

script.description: Default script for this version (Greek or Hebrew). If unset, assume Latin.

abbr.description: Abbreviations this version’s content cites by id, such as critical-edition and manuscript sigla. Each version defines its own, and an id resolves only within its own version, since the same code can mean different things in different editions.

testaments.description: Optional per-testament overrides for script and morphology.

name.description: Name of the book in this version

title.description: Title of the book in this version

chapters.description: Number of chapters in this book for this version

order.description: Order of the book in this version

books.description: List of books included in this version with their order.

_id.description: Identifier that an `abbr` content node points at, e.g., NA27, OM, MS-ALEPH.

name.description: How the abbreviation prints. Content rather than plain text, so its parts can carry marks, e.g., NA followed by a superscript 27.

description.description: What the abbreviation stands for. Text and markdown exports omit it. The web reader shows it on hover or in a modal.

script.description: Script override for this testament (Greek or Hebrew). If unset, assume Latin.
